description: This Java class defines an Android activity 'PictureDetailsActivity' that manages animated transitions for displaying a zoomed-in picture with description, including enter and exit animations involving scaling, translation, color filtering, and background fade effects.

classes.name: PictureDetailsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a picture with animated transition effects, including scaling, translation, color filtering, and background fade, for a detailed view of a photo with description.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, retrieves data from intent extras, and prepares for the enter animation.

methods.name: runEnterAnimation
methods.description: Performs the animation to scale and move the image from thumbnail to full size, fade in background, colorize image from grayscale to color, and slide in description.

methods.name: runExitAnimation
methods.description: Performs the reverse animation to scale and move the image back to thumbnail size, fade out background, revert color filter, and slide out description, then executes a callback.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides default back button behavior to run the exit animation before finishing the activity.

methods.name: setSaturation
methods.description: Adjusts the saturation of the image's color filter, used during colorization and decolorization animations.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Overrides activity finish to disable default transition animations.
